function esc(s){return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c];});}

function render(lang){
var t=L[lang]||L.en; curLang=lang;
document.documentElement.lang=lang;
document.querySelectorAll('[data-t]').forEach(function(el){var k=el.getAttribute('data-t'); if(t[k]!=null) el.textContent=t[k];});
document.querySelectorAll('[data-t-alt]').forEach(function(el){var k=el.getAttribute('data-t-alt'); if(t[k]!=null) el.alt=t[k];});
document.querySelectorAll('.langs button').forEach(function(b){b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',b.getAttribute('data-lang')===lang?'true':'false');});
document.getElementById('services-grid').innerHTML=t.svc.map(function(s,i){
return '<article class="svc"><div class="top"><span class="num">0'+(i+1)+'</span><svg width="30" height="30" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#15161A" stroke-width="1.6" aria-hidden="true">'+icons[i]+'</svg></div><h3>'+esc(s[0])+'</h3><p>'+esc(s[1])+'</p></article>';}).join('');
document.getElementById('steps').innerHTML=t.steps.map(function(s,i){
return '<li><span class="n">'+(i+1)+'</span><div><h3>'+esc(s[0])+'</h3><p>'+esc(s[1])+'</p></div></li>';}).join('');
document.getElementById('al-chips').innerHTML=t.chips.map(function(c){return '<li>'+esc(c)+'</li>';}).join('');
document.getElementById('ag-chips').innerHTML=t.agchips.map(function(c){return '<li>'+esc(c)+'</li>';}).join('');
document.querySelectorAll('.plan-thumb').forEach(function(b){b.setAttribute('data-label',t.planLabel);});
var sel=document.getElementById('types'), cur=sel.selectedIndex;
sel.innerHTML=t.types.map(function(o){return '<option>'+esc(o)+'</option>';}).join('');
if(cur>0) sel.selectedIndex=cur;
try{localStorage.setItem('ironLang',lang);}catch(e){}
}
document.querySelectorAll('.langs button').forEach(function(b){b.addEventListener('click',function(){render(b.getAttribute('data-lang'));});});


/* designed vs built tabs */
document.querySelectorAll('.cmp-tab').forEach(function(tb){tb.addEventListener('click',function(){
var n=tb.getAttribute('data-pair');
document.querySelectorAll('.cmp-tab').forEach(function(x){x.setAttribute('aria-selected',x===tb?'true':'false');});
document.querySelectorAll('.cmp-pair').forEach(function(pn){if(pn.getAttribute('data-pane')===n) pn.removeAttribute('hidden'); else pn.setAttribute('hidden','');});
});});

var FORM_ENDPOINT='https://formsubmit.co/ajax/'+CONTACT_EMAIL;
document.getElementById('lead').addEventListener('submit',function(e){
e.preventDefault();
var f=e.target,st=document.getElementById('fstatus'),btn=f.querySelector('button[type=submit]'),lang=document.documentElement.lang||'en',t=L[lang]||L.en;
if(!f.elements.phone.value.trim()&&!f.elements.email.value.trim()){st.textContent=t.fNeed;return;}
var subj='Iron Services — '+(f.elements.type.value||'New consultation request');
var data={name:f.elements.name.value,phone:f.elements.phone.value,email:f.elements.email.value,project_type:f.elements.type.value,location:f.elements.loc.value,message:f.elements.msg.value,language:lang,_subject:subj,_template:'table',_captcha:'false'};
if(f.elements.email.value)data._replyto=f.elements.email.value;
function viaMail(){var lines=[];['name','phone','email','type','loc','msg'].forEach(function(n){var v=f.elements[n].value;if(v)lines.push(n+': '+v);});
 window.location.href='mailto:'+CONTACT_EMAIL+'?subject='+encodeURIComponent(subj)+'&body='+encodeURIComponent(lines.join('\n'));}
btn.disabled=true;st.textContent=t.fSending;
fetch(FORM_ENDPOINT,{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','Accept':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify(data)})
.then(function(r){return r.json().catch(function(){return {};}).then(function(j){
 if(r.ok&&(j.success===true||j.success==='true')){st.textContent=t.fSent;f.reset();}else{throw new Error('send');}});})
.catch(function(){st.textContent=t.fError;viaMail();})
.then(function(){btn.disabled=false;});
});

rv.forEach(function(el){io.observe(el);});
} else { rv.forEach(function(el){el.classList.add('in');}); }

render(start);

 },{passive:true});

<script>
(function(){
var stage=document.getElementById('mapstage'),svg=document.getElementById('worldmap');if(!svg)return;
var reduce=window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)').matches;
var HH=432.8,rst=document.getElementById('mapreset'),detail=document.getElementById('mapdetail'),mdhead=document.getElementById('mdhead'),wrap=document.getElementById('projmap');
var pins={};[].forEach.call(svg.querySelectorAll('.pin'),function(g){pins[g.getAttribute('data-loc')]={g:g,k:g.querySelector('.pk'),x:+g.getAttribute('data-x'),y:+g.getAttribute('data-y')};});
var TARGET={office:{at:['office'],w:230},alvear:{at:['alvear','allegra'],w:210},allegra:{at:['alvear','allegra'],w:210},ve:{at:['ve'],w:330},co:{at:['co'],w:330}};
var view={cx:350,cy:255,w:640},cur=null,raf=0;
function box(){var r=stage.getBoundingClientRect();return {w:r.width||900,h:r.height||500};}
function home(){var b=box();return b.w<640?{cx:318,cy:262,w:360}:{cx:352,cy:258,w:660};}
function apply(){
 var b=box(),A=b.h/b.w,h=view.w*A,k=view.w/b.w;
 svg.setAttribute('viewBox',(view.cx-view.w/2).toFixed(2)+' '+(view.cy-h/2).toFixed(2)+' '+view.w.toFixed(2)+' '+h.toFixed(2));
 for(var id in pins){var p=pins[id];p.g.setAttribute('transform','translate('+p.x+' '+p.y+')');p.k.setAttribute('transform','scale('+k.toFixed(4)+')');}
}
function go(t,instant){
 cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
 if(instant||reduce){view=t;apply();return;}
 var s={cx:view.cx,cy:view.cy,w:view.w},t0=null,D=1000;
 function ease(x){return x<.5?4*x*x*x:1-Math.pow(-2*x+2,3)/2;}
 function step(ts){if(t0===null)t0=ts;var p=Math.min(1,(ts-t0)/D),e=ease(p);
  var lw=Math.log(s.w)+(Math.log(t.w)-Math.log(s.w))*e;
  view={cx:s.cx+(t.cx-s.cx)*e,cy:s.cy+(t.cy-s.cy)*e,w:Math.exp(lw)};apply();
  if(p<1)raf=requestAnimationFrame(step);}
 raf=requestAnimationFrame(step);
}
function hot(id,on){if(pins[id])pins[id].g.classList.toggle('hot',on);}
[].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.locbtn img[data-from]'),function(im){
 var q=im.getAttribute('data-from'),src=q.charAt(0)==='.'?document.querySelector(q):document.querySelector('[data-cap="'+q+'"] img');
 if(src)im.src=src.src;});
function showDetail(id){
 [].forEach.call(detail.querySelectorAll('[data-loc]'),function(el){
  var on=el.getAttribute('data-loc')===id;el.hidden=!on;
  if(on&&el.classList.contains('reveal'))el.classList.add('in');});
}
function paint(){
 [].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.locbtn'),function(b){b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',b.getAttribute('data-loc')===cur?'true':'false');});
 for(var k in pins){var g=pins[k].g;g.classList.toggle('active',k===cur);g.classList.toggle('dim',!!cur&&k!==cur);}
 rst.hidden=!cur;mdhead.hidden=!cur;
}
function scrollMap(){var top=wrap.getBoundingClientRect().top;
 if(Math.abs(top-84)>40)window.scrollTo({top:top+(window.pageYOffset||0)-84,behavior:reduce?'auto':'smooth'});}
function select(id,noScroll,instant){
 cur=id;paint();showDetail(id);
 var T=TARGET[id],cx=0,cy=0;T.at.forEach(function(a){cx+=pins[a].x;cy+=pins[a].y;});
 var bw=box().w,sh=bw<640?({alvear:-47,allegra:-47,ve:85,co:-85,office:70}[id]||0)*T.w/bw:0;
 go({cx:cx/T.at.length+sh,cy:cy/T.at.length,w:T.w},instant);
 if(!noScroll)scrollMap();
}
function reset(scroll){
 cur=null;paint();showDetail('office');go(home());if(scroll)scrollMap();
}
for(var id in pins){(function(id){var g=pins[id].g;
 g.addEventListener('click',function(){if(cur===id)reset();else select(id)});
 g.addEventListener('mouseenter',function(){hot(id,true)});g.addEventListener('mouseleave',function(){hot(id,false)});})(id);}
[].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.locbtn'),function(b){var id=b.getAttribute('data-loc');

 b.addEventListener('mouseenter',function(){hot(id,true)});b.addEventListener('mouseleave',function(){hot(id,false)});
 b.addEventListener('focus',function(){hot(id,true)});b.addEventListener('blur',function(){hot(id,false)});});
rst.addEventListener('click',function(){reset(false)});
mdhead.querySelector('.mdback').addEventListener('click',function(){reset(true)});
var rz;window.addEventListener('resize',function(){clearTimeout(rz);rz=setTimeout(function(){if(cur)select(cur,true,true);else{view=home();apply();}},120);});
showDetail('office');view=home();apply();
if('ResizeObserver' in window)new ResizeObserver(function(){apply();}).observe(stage);
})();
</script>
<script>
(function(){

function upd(){tick=false;
 var lis=sec.querySelectorAll('.psteps li');if(!lis.length)return;
 var mobile=window.innerWidth<=900,mid=mobile?col.getBoundingClientRect().bottom+80:window.innerHeight*.5,best=0,bd=1e9;
 [].forEach.call(lis,function(li,i){var d=Math.abs(li.getBoundingClientRect().top+60-mid);if(d<bd){bd=d;best=i;}});
 [].forEach.call(lis,function(li,i){li.classList.toggle('on',i===best);li.classList.toggle('done',i<best);});

 imgs.forEach(function(im,j){im.classList.toggle('on',j===k);});
 cap.textContent=imgs[k].alt||'';num.textContent='0'+(best+1);
}

})();
